none: PAS BM-E83E2D: BM-E83E2D: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the second or third centuries AD. The sealing is rectangular in shape and section, with legends in relief on both the upper and lower surfaces. The upper legend reads 'G.I.ET.C'. The lower legend read 'M.LGF'. The sealing appears to be vertically pierced with the piercing visible centrally in both the upper and lower section.
